_description: State relocation: CA (8%) for 2026-2029, then FL (0%) from 2030. Tests that state tax rate changes at the relocation year.
_rationale: Single filer, $100k pension, 0% growth/inflation/stddev. Gross $100k, std deduction $16,100, taxable $83,900. Federal tax $13,170 (10% on $12,400 + 12% on $38,000 + 22% on $33,500). CA state tax = $100k × 8% = $8,000. Net with CA = $78,830/yr. Net with FL = $86,830/yr. Portfolio grows by net income each year.
name: State Relocation Basic
